scripts.setup:local: npm install && npm --prefix src/frontend install && npm --prefix src/backend install
scripts.setup:backend: npm --prefix src/backend install && npm run setup:services
scripts.setup:services: npm --prefix src/backend/gateway install && npm --prefix src/backend/points-engine install && npm --prefix src/backend/campaign-service install && npm --prefix src/backend/member-service install && npm --prefix src/backend/segment-service install && npm --prefix src/backend/notification-service install && npm --prefix src/backend/reward-service install
scripts.build:services: npm --prefix src/backend/gateway run build && npm --prefix src/backend/points-engine run build && npm --prefix src/backend/campaign-service run build && npm --prefix src/backend/member-service run build && npm --prefix src/backend/segment-service run build && npm --prefix src/backend/notification-service run build && npm --prefix src/backend/reward-service run build
scripts.build:all: npm run build:backend && npm run build:services && npm run build:frontend
scripts.start:local: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run dev"
scripts.restart:local: npm run clean:ports && npm run start:local
